Security & network verification

Private beta: use synthetic or non-sensitive documents until security and output validation are complete.

Processing model

Browser libraries read local files, render pages and produce downloads. The host authenticates access and serves assets. Libraries and OCR models load from external hosts including jsDelivr and SheetJS. No independent security audit has been performed.

Verify network behavior

  1. Create a synthetic document containing a unique marker.
  2. Open developer tools → Network, enable Preserve log, and clear the log.
  3. Select the file, run a tool and download its output.
  4. Inspect requests, URLs and bodies for the marker, filenames and document bytes. They should not be transmitted.
  5. Repeat after clearing caches, including OCR. Model downloads are expected; document uploads are not.

This is a manual test procedure, not a completed audit or proof against every exfiltration path.

Boundaries

  • No encrypted cloud vault, identity verification or cryptographic signature service.
  • Sanitization removes selected dictionary entries, not every possible hidden object; it is not malware scanning or verified data erasure.
  • Redaction and pattern detection require independent verification.
  • External dependencies and browser vulnerabilities remain risks.
  • Full offline processing is not currently supported.
